top_signals.title: Indian Software Stocks Outperform AI Peers by Most on Record
top_signals.summary: India’s information-technology stocks outperformed global semiconductor shares by the widest margin on record this week, with analysts expecting the trend to continue as the artificial-intelligence trade wobbles.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Shahin Vallée: Europe Must Rebalance Trade with China
top_signals.summary: As the EU weighs new measures to block Chinese imports, Shahin Vallée of the German Council on Foreign Relations and formerly of the French Ministry of the Economy and Finance, joins Bloomberg's Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson, and Tom Mackenzie on "The Opening Trade." "I think more than a measure to rebalance trade with China, it is a measure to try to rebalance the negotiations that are taking place." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
